source_terms: Exact PR742 base/head BSD-3-Clause notices, bootstrap MACS BSD-3-Clause and upstream Apache-2.0 notices accompany the snapshot and are checked against prior published evidence.
material: One frozen MACS PR742 no-model sequential reconstruction/control archive, exact task lineage, actual build dependency receipts, accounting and notices. No package wheels, Docker image bytes or new biological inputs are published.
scientific_data: Repository regression-output text fixtures included in the original reviewed MACS patch lineage are adapted outputs, not newly acquired biological samples. No BAM, BAI, sequencing archive, image or Docker image is included. The publication scanner rejects non-text members except recursively inspected archive wrappers, unsafe members, credential signals and Git binary patches.
credential_boundary: Remote runs use isolated secrets with no GitHub or model credentials. Administrative submission files are excluded. All text and nested archive members must pass bounded inspection before staging/publication.
excluded: Full newly fetched issue-741 API snapshot
retention: Public research evidence only, retained while cited. This does not publish a task dataset, establish solver scores or guarantee exact-image reproduction.
limitation: Positive, negative and incomplete stage outcomes are preserved. Images are not distributed; hashes identify the recorded dependency artifacts.
automatic_manifest_generation: Permit only this fixed run ID and reviewed source family. The committed generator checks archive identity, nested text members, credential signals, notice digests and a 4-MiB/16-file bound before append-only publication. The generated manifest is execution evidence; its contents need no per-run human or model repair.
